name: Easy Pressure Cooker Mango-Pineapple Chicken Tacos with Avocado & Cilantro

instructions.primary_message: Place salsa, mango, pineapple (do not drain), sugar, and salt in a medium bowl. Stir to combine the sauce.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 cups fresh salsa
1 cup frozen mango
1 (227 g) can pineapple chunks
2 tbsp brown sugar
1 tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Season chicken with salt and pepper. Place in a 6-quart pressure cooker insert and pour sauce over top. Lock lid and set to pressure cook on HIGH for 10 minutes. Once done, allow the pressure to release naturally for 10 minutes, then carefully release any remaining pressure and remove the lid.
instructions.secondary_message:
907 g chicken breasts, boneless skinless
½ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: After releasing the pressure, remove chicken to a cutting board and, using two forks, shred the chicken into bite-sized pieces. Set aside.

Place water and cornstarch in a small bowl, then whisk to combine the slurry. Add slurry to the pressure cooker with the sauce, stirring constantly. Set pressure cooker to sauté on HIGH and cook, stirring occasionally, until sauce is thickened, 2-3 minutes. Return chicken to the pressure cooker and stir to coat in sauce.

Meanwhile, wash, dry, halve, and pit avocados; using a spoon, scoop out the flesh and slice crosswise into thin half-moons. Wash, dry, and shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems. Place both on a plate.
Warm tortillas in a skillet, oven, or microwave (optional).
To serve, divide tortillas between plates, fill with saucy chicken, then top with avocado and cilantro. Enjoy!
